description.value: 小酒馆 Tasty BBQ & Beer Bar is a Chinese grill and bistro in Richmond, BC, specializing in BBQ skewers, grilled seafood, and Chinese small plates. The extensive menu spans Xinjiang-style lamb skewers and desert mutton to hand-caught seafood platters, cold dishes, and fried bistro bites, making it a substantive meal stop for hungry cyclists. The restaurant also supports online ordering for takeout.
